name: credit-usage-card
title: Credit Usage Card
description: A monospace credit-usage card: a 56.4% headline, an auto-switch toggle, a long segmented orange meter, a period picker, a four-row usage table and small export and plan actions.
use: A SaaS or API product shows how much of a monthly quota is spent and which models drove it.
avoid: Real-time metering: the figures are fixed props and there is no live refresh or error state.
a11y: Controls are buttons with titles, but the usage table is built from divs and the toggle has no switch role or state. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall dark monospace card. A small Credits Used label over a large 56.4% sits beside a two-line caption and a tiny green toggle. Seventy-five thin orange bars form a meter, then credit labels, a dashed divider, a Usage History heading with a 30 Days pill, a four-column table and a footer with a Manage plan pill.
behaves: The toggle springs its knob between green and grey, and the period pill opens a compact popover of durations with a tick on the chosen one. Usage rows brighten on hover, and the download icon flashes green for a moment after a CSV export.
customise: Percentage, the credit labels and the usage history array are props; auto-switch, view-all and plan callbacks are optional, while colours and the 75-segment meter are fixed.
weight: light: Seventy-five tiny meter bars and a small popover; nothing animates in a loop.
